backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor handling user profiles, authorization, attendance tracking, and ranking logic with sorting and profile updates.
backend/validation.mo: Validation module enforcing name rules including length, allowed characters, and reserved-word checks with traps on failure.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a UI change to add a themed subtitle on the Home Dashboard page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing summaries of various frontend modules and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme CSS variables and global background/foreground settings.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting dark background, meta tags, favicon, and mounting the React app.
frontend/index.ts: Notes unsupported features including FCM and push notifications.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling routing, theme initialization, profile sync, service worker cleanup, and global UI structure.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup import/export utilities creating JSON backups and restoring state with validation.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup schema with versioning, validation, and migration merging defaults for settings and reminder-related fields.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Bunkab: Displays bunkable class count with loading, error, and status‑based UI using attendance calculations.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Shows subject attendance stats with progress, danger alerts, streaks, and trend badges.
Provides the app’s main layout with header, footer, and padded content area.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Bottom sheet for marking today’s scheduled classes with selectable attendance statuses.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Five‑tab bottom navigation bar with icons and active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/pastAttendance/M: Flow for selecting a past date and marking attendance for scheduled classes, with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Displays app version info and founder details in an about section card.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: UI card that exports current app state to a backup file and imports backups with confirmation before restoring.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Logout card with a confirmation dialog that runs logout and clears local data even if server deletion fails.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings with permission requests, category toggles, Android-specific limitations, and test notification sending.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Editable profile name field with validation, save/cancel flow, and error display.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Lets users set a target attendance percentage using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Appearance settings card allowing selection of theme mode and color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable text and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu providing edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing subjects with validation and name conflict checks.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that classifies auth errors and shows session-expired or generic recovery UI with reload handling.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Empty placeholder file for an initial load splash component.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Shows toast-based non-blocking error notifications when an error prop is provided.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Utility functions for computing attendance stats, safe bunk counts, required classes, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, user profile, points, and milestones.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for subjects, events, settings, user profiles, milestones, and the overall app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Calculates prediction trends, trend direction, and motivational streak messages.
frontend/src/domain/scheduleForDate.ts: Computes scheduled classes for a date using timetable slots and class exchanges.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Utilities for computing continuous streaks and determining milestone eligibility and identifiers.
Validates display names with length checks and allowed character rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRecovery.ts: Provides logout and error-recovery helpers that clear app state, caches, and identity on authorization failures.
frontend/src/hooks/useBunkableClasses.ts: Fetches required attendance percentage and computes how many classes can be skipped based on actor calculations.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyAttendanceRem: Schedules a daily 7 PM reminder if attendance isn’t marked and handles notification sending and failure feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, persistence, and identity loading using AuthClient within a React context.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, theme variables, dark mode rules, animations, and premium calendar styling.
frontend/src/lib/authErrorHandling.ts: Classifies authorization errors into safe user messages and indicates whether logout is required.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports BunkPro branding constants and functions to select logo assets.
frontend/src/lib/platform.ts: Detects whether the app is running on Android via userAgent APIs.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides common helpers for class merging, date formatting, date comparisons, ID generation, and subject colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app by mounting React, providing QueryClient and InternetIdentity contexts.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Builds short notification titles and bodies for marking classes, including multi-status summaries.
frontend/src/notifications/notificationL: Provides static text describing browser-only notification support, limitations, and permission messages.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with support checks, permission handling, sending notifications, and test notifications.
frontend/src/notifications/reminderFailu: Returns rate-limited, user-friendly failure messages for reminder notification errors.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Displays the dashboard, checks streak milestones, awards points, sends reward notifications, and handles attendance-related actions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple name-based login form with validation and async submit simulation.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings screen for profile editing, notifications, appearance, backup, and logout with backend sync and cleanup.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Shows overall attendance statistics, percentages, and breakdown cards using calculated totals.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Renders a detailed subject view with attendance stats, safe bunk/required calculators, and edit/delete/reset actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Displays and edits a weekly timetable grid with subject assignments per day and time slot.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Generates lightweight animated confetti particles for celebratory effects.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Provides legacy wrapper functions that delegate ranking operations to RankingService while converting responses to older formats.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Provides styled rank badges, including special designs for ranks 1–3 and gradient badges for others.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: Implements localStorage-based caching for weekly rankings with validation and safe error handling.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines ranking data models and utilities for mapping and validating leaderboard entries.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Handles fetching paginated ranking data and submitting points through backend actor calls.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Displays the leaderboard with polling, error handling, auto-scroll, and confetti for top ranks.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Handles ranking fetch, caching fallback, auth error checks, pagination fetch, and point submission via RankingRepository.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads user and actor context and renders the main ranking screen.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Defines a React context store with load/save persistence, state restoration, and debounced updates.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Loads and saves app state via IndexedDB and merges missing fields with defaults for forward compatibility.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Provides low-level IndexedDB helpers to save, load, and clear the app state object store.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies light/dark themes and variant settings to the DOM and listens for system theme changes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL/session parameters for both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, animations, containers, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current version, planned features, architectural guidelines, and known issues for the BunkPro app, including attendance flows, notifications, branding, and ranking logic. Contains detailed scope notes and bug lists for ongoing development and debugging.
